reference_answer: Financial HQ UI declares @playwright/test ^1.60.0 and its pinned yarn.lock resolves 1.60.0, so no Playwright upgrade is needed for file input uploads, simulated drag/drop, HAR capture or HAR replay. Use locator.setInputFiles for a file input; a drop zone that consumes DataTransfer.files needs an appropriate drag/drop event with a populated DataTransfer, while locator.dragTo targets in-page draggable elements. HAR recording is available through browser.newContext({recordHar:{path}}), the Playwright CLI --save-har, or routeFromHAR({update:true}); close the context to flush the HAR, then routeFromHAR to replay. Distinguish Playwright trace and HAR; consider sensitive request data and service-worker limitations. The existing config enables traces/screenshots but does not itself configure HAR capture.

sources.title: Playwright file uploads and drag/drop
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Upload files section uses locator.setInputFiles or fileChooser.setFiles. Drag and Drop section uses locator.dragTo for element drags and lower-level mouse actions.

sources.title: Playwright locator setInputFiles
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: setInputFiles is supported since v1.14 for input[type=file], including in-memory buffers.

sources.title: Playwright HAR mocking guide
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Record via --save-har, browser.newContext recordHar or routeFromHAR update; routeFromHAR replays saved requests.

sources.title: Playwright HAR API
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: routeFromHAR added v1.23. The HAR update file is written when the context closes. Service-worker intercepted requests are not served from HAR.

facts: playwright.config.ts records trace on failure and screenshots on failure; no recordHar setting.
Existing e2e tests are present under e2e/. No tracked test uses recordHar, routeFromHAR, setInputFiles or DataTransfer.

ambiguities: 'File drops' may mean an HTML file input or a custom drop zone; the test interaction differs.
'Capture HARs' may mean recording raw traffic, replaying network data, or preserving test failure diagnostics.
decision_changing_errors: Recommending an upgrade solely to obtain HAR support or file upload support in Playwright 1.60.
Treating a Playwright trace as a HAR.
Assuming locator.dragTo automatically attaches an OS file to a custom drop zone.
